hero.tagline: Where heavenly food, relaxation and special moments come together.
hero.headline: Heaven is a place on earth. Lunch. Relax. Celebrate.
hero.description: Enjoy our cosy restaurant, relaxing sauna and beautiful event spaces for every occasion.

lunchroom.title: The Lunchroom
lunchroom.description: Enjoy, fresh food, great coffee, and a welcoming atmosphere. A place to relax, connect, and enjoy life's simple pleasures.

sauna.title: Sauna
sauna.description: Escape the rush of a daily life and enjoy a moment of pure relaxation in our peaceful wellness environment.

events.title: Events & Activities
events.subtitle: Multifunctional space
events.description: From private celebrations and business gatherings to mindfulness sessions and workshops. A versatile space designed to connect, inspire and create memorable moments.

relaxEnjoy.title: Relax. Enjoy.
relaxEnjoy.subtitle: A place where life slows down and moments matter.
relaxEnjoy.description1: At heaven on Earth, every visit is an invitation to enjoy. Start your day with a wholesome breakfast, have a fresh lunch, enjoy a coffee or a ice-cream on our sunny terrace, relax in our wellness facilities, or gather with friends, family and colleagues to celebrate life special moments.
relaxEnjoy.description2: Whether you're seeking relaxation, connection, or simply a beautiful place to spend your time, you'll find it here.

weddings.title: Weddings
weddings.description: From intimate ceremonies, to elegant receptions & dinners to a big celebration party. Heaven on Earth offers a warm and beautiful atmosphere where cherished memories are made and every detail is thoughtfully considered.

babyshowers.title: Babyshowers & Gender Reveals
babyshowers.subtitle: A beautiful place to start new beginnings.
babyshowers.description: Gather with family and friends in a charming setting and make a baby shower or gender reveal a moment to remember.

bachelorParties.title: Bachelor & Bachelorette Parties
bachelorParties.subtitle: Celebrate before the big day in style.
bachelorParties.description: Whether you're planning a relaxed gathering, a high beer, wine, cocktail, a wellness experience, or an workshop for a unforgettable day with friends, Heaven on Earth offers the perfect setting to celebrate this special occasion together.

corporateEvents.title: Corporate Events & Meetings
corporateEvents.subtitle: Bring your team together in a unique setting.
corporateEvents.description: From productive meetings and inspiring team building workshops to company celebrations and networking events, Heaven on Earth provides the perfect atmosphere to connect, collaborate and create lasting impressions.

mindfulness.title: Mindfulness & Workshops
mindfulness.description: From meditation and breathwork to coaching and inspiring workshops. A place to slow down, release stress, and let go of built-up tension. Discover different ways to cultivate more calm, balance, and meaningful connection in everyday life.

saltRoom.title: Salt Room & Halotherapy
saltRoom.description: Step into a calming salt room designed for deep relaxation and natural well-being. Halotherapy uses microscopic salt particles released into the air, creating a soothing environment that supports comfortable breathing and skin wellness while helping you slow down, unwind and recharge.

fullPolicy.sec1Lead: Customers may cancel or reschedule a wellness reservation up to {{hours}} before the scheduled start time.
fullPolicy.sec1Point1Title: More than 24 hours before the session:
fullPolicy.sec1Point1Text: Customers may cancel or reschedule their reservation in accordance with the applicable refund, credit, and booking policies.
fullPolicy.sec1Point2Text: Cancellations and rescheduling are no longer permitted free of charge. The applicable late cancellation policy will apply.
fullPolicy.sec1Point3Title: At or after the scheduled start time:
fullPolicy.sec1Point3Text: Cancellations or changes are not permitted under the standard cancellation policy.
fullPolicy.sec2Title: 2. Policy for Members and Session-Pass Holders
fullPolicy.sec2Lead: The same 24-hour cancellation and rescheduling policy applies to all members and session-pass holders.
fullPolicy.sec2Point1Title: Timely cancellation (more than 24 hours in advance):
fullPolicy.sec2Point1Text: The session or credit used for the booking will be returned to the customer's account and made available for future bookings.
fullPolicy.sec2Point2Text: The booked session or credit will be considered used and will not be restored.
fullPolicy.sec2Point3Text: If a customer fails to attend without cancelling in accordance with the policy, the session or credit will not be restored.
fullPolicy.sec3Text: Refunds, credits, and the restoration of sessions are subject to the applicable payment, membership, and session-pass terms. A timely cancellation does not automatically guarantee a monetary refund. Eligible refunds or credits will be processed according to the rules applicable to the original booking and payment method.
fullPolicy.sec4Text: The cancellation and rescheduling policy is displayed during the booking process and included in the booking confirmation. By completing a reservation, customers acknowledge that they have read and accepted the applicable cancellation, rescheduling, refund, and credit rules.
fullPolicy.agreeCheckbox: I have read, understood, and accept the {{policyName}}, including the 24-hour notice requirement.
fullPolicy.mustAcceptPolicyError: Please read and accept the Cancellation, Rescheduling & Refund Policy to proceed.
